content: Customer Shaurya Joshi contacted insurance agent Anita Sharma to discuss an upcoming auto policy renewal (Policy AP-001234). The customer received a renewal notification and inquired about confirming details or making changes. The agent identified the policy, noting it is scheduled to auto-renew on the 20th of the current month, and asked the customer whether they intended to modify their coverage or keep it as is.

action_items: Customer to decide whether to change coverage or maintain current terms for the upcoming renewal on the 20th.
